# Code of Conduct

We are committed to a welcoming, harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of background or experience level.

## Expected behavior
- Be respectful and constructive. Assume good intent.
- Use inclusive language; offer help generously.
- Accept feedback gracefully; focus on improving the work.

## Unacceptable behavior
- Harassment, discrimination, or personal attacks.
- Doxxing or sharing private information.
- Disruptive behavior that derails collaboration.

## Reporting
If you experience or witness a problem, please open a private Issue labeled `status:needs-info` or contact a maintainer directly.

## Enforcement
Maintainers may edit, remove, or reject contributions that violate this policy and may take further action as appropriate.

This policy applies to all project spaces (issues, PRs, docs, and any related communication).
